author: Dissident Teacher
text:
Lose the laptops; add Cornell Notes.

My students learn so much faster because Cornell notes make reviews  and repetition part of the lesson, and make studying after the lesson much more efficient. This means we also free up instructional days so we can learn  more over the course of the year.
